notes.color: All color is consumed from CSS custom properties; components never hardcode hex values. The dark palette is the default; light values are a designed counterpart under [data-theme=light].
notes.typography: Display is Space Grotesk 600, UI is Space Grotesk 400–500, data is JetBrains Mono. Latin data keeps JetBrains Mono; zh-CN text falls back to PingFang SC.
notes.motion: Only three ambient motions exist: signal-sweep (~6s), attention pulse (~1.6s), and the caret blink (~1.1s). Everything else is a ≤120ms ease-out state change. Motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
notes.panel: Translucent hull/72% fill, 1px line border, 8px radius, backdrop blur. The corner brackets are reserved for the page's primary panel — one per screen.
notes.button: Primary (beam fill), secondary (line border), ghost (no border, dim → text), danger (breach fill). Loading and disabled use the same reduced-opacity treatment.
notes.iconButton: Square button carrying only a glyph. Used wherever a control needs a visual but no label — kebabs in tables, in-line tool buttons.
notes.badge: Mono label with tracked uppercase. The border picks up the variant tint; the background is a subtle wash so badges read as a stamp against a panel.
notes.banner: Full-width notice with leading dot, label, body, optional trailing action. Tones inherit the system's signal colors.
notes.table: Semantic <table> for the tools list and other data grids. Mono cells, tracked column headers, right-align numeric columns.
notes.dataRow: Definition-list row (dt + dd) with mono values. Used on the starter page and reused on settings, env, and plugin detail pages.
notes.emptyState: Page-level 'nothing to show' panel. Eyebrow follows the HUD ▸ GROUP / SECTION convention so the empty context is clear.
notes.progressDot: Status dot (beam / flare / breach / dim) with the attention-pulse animation when the tone is flare/breach — the only ambient motion attached to a state component.
